t: What comes after the ones he named
a: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ قَرْنِي، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ
p: Khayru-n-nāsi qarnī, thumma-lladhīna yalūnahum, thumma-lladhīna yalūnahum
m: The best of people are my generation, then those who come after them, then those who come after them.
